p2_deterministic_workflow.scope: interface-level deterministic demonstration only; not an autonomous model session
p2_deterministic_workflow.description: single compact case inspection (which verifies internally) plus identity-bound baseline reuse; no separate verification call, shell, replay or EU4 launch

interface_reduction_vs_p1_output.note: compares interface output volume only; it does not replace the P1 agent's 80 tool calls or reasoning

unresolved_interval.note: search_start_event is an operational search bound, not a matching observation

next_checkpoint.reason: the default framebuffer differs at the first divergent checkpoint; capture an fb:0 checkpoint near the midpoint of the unresolved interval to bisect the origin

limitations: No new model-driven DSH session was run: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY is absent in this environment, so the P2 measurement is the deterministic native-interface workflow plus the preserved P1 session export, not a new model turn.
GL-versus-Metal replay counts and checkpoint GPU overhead are not carried in the session export; they remain explicit nulls in dsh_efficiency.
No EU4 launch and no replay were performed for this evidence; the existing verified baseline is reused.

notes: The floor is applied to executed tests (ran - skipped).
The 42 skips include the classified live-only module, platform-only hosts and optional-QBDI TR3 tests.

corrections.baseline_reuse: record/check now require gfx_replay_case.verify(), actual on-disk payload validation, a completed replay/readback and the renderer include closure
corrections.compact_output: UTF-8 byte cap including the emitted newline; essential identity/causal fields preserved; exact output_bytes reported
corrections.failure_classification: explicit status precedence; shader/replay correctness failures are tool failures; dependency_unavailable is separate from graphics_unavailable
corrections.test_floor: counts executed tests (ran - skipped) and includes profile/min_tests in the dedup identity
corrections.live_gate: live case must pass gfx_replay_case.verify() and be independently reproducible
corrections.replay_host_dependency: one shared automation.replay_host_dependencies enumerator drives both build_replay_host and case_baseline; local header closure, compiler, flags and build env are all in the build identity
corrections.payload_single_pass: case_baseline uses gfx_replay_case.verify() as the single payload/content hashing pass; no duplicate payload walker
corrections.replay_stage: a reusable baseline requires replay stage=complete, status=ok and readback=true
corrections.mandatory_test_execution: test_profiles verify executes each required test id and rejects dynamic skips
corrections.compact_essential_cap: if essential identity/causal fields cannot fit, the envelope fails explicitly with output_cap_exceeded rather than silently dropping them
corrections.native_harness_stability: live-capture harness startup waits and deadline were widened; this is test-only timing robustness under external machine load, not a behavioral change

replay_host_dependency_correction.unchanged_rebuild_test: same test: second call performs no subprocess
replay_host_dependency_correction.build_publication: private temp output, atomic rename, exclusive file lock, binary sha256 in stamp; failed/timeout builds remove binary and stamp
